plan: Queue jungle as primary. It is Xeebs's best role at 52.6% over 322 games (overall is 50.3%). Set midlane as secondary, not the other way around.
Stop queueing carry: 42.9% over 196 games is costing real VP. When auto-filled there, play the safest comfort pick, not a learning pick.
Comfort-hero rule for the climb: Khaimera. Compared with the average player on the same hero, Xeebs wins about 3.7 more games per 100 on it.
Xeebs's champion pool is 11+ heroes wide and the top three are only 40% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
Park Drongo, Serath for ranked: 37% over 51; 38% over 50. Keep them for normals.
The math: Xeebs is at 375 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 692.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)
field baselines are all-ranks aggregates from our current-patch match sample, not Gold-bracket-specific yet
winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why

insights.title: Xeebs is a closer, not a marathoner
insights.finding: Games under 28 minutes: 67%. Past 32: 50%. Press early leads and call objectives; do not let games drift.
insights.receipt: wins 12 of 18 short games vs 5 of 10 long ones, recent sample

insights.title: Xeebs is running hotter than the career line

insights.title: Vision is Xeebs's cheapest upgrade
insights.finding: 4.8 wards per game, 56% of the squad average. Wards cost nothing and they are being left in the shop.

insights.title: Khaimera is the long-term relationship
insights.finding: 179 games and Xeebs genuinely out-pilots the field on Khaimera — about 3.7 more wins per 100 games than the average Khaimera player. The hours show.

insights.title: Mr_Meat31 brings out Xeebs's best
insights.finding: Xeebs's record alongside Mr_Meat31 is 54% over 294 ranked games — the strongest pairing in the stack. When only two of the squad queue, make it this pair.
